page_title: RAY 1-2 SEV | Rayo Vallecano v Sevilla 05/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The main referee, Francisco Maeso, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) plays a through ball but overhits it.
88' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Ivan Balliu.
86' Francisco has decided to make a change. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Alfonso Espino.
86' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
83' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
82' Lucien Agoume just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) replaces him.
81' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) picks up an injury.
78' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
76' Here comes a substitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Jesus Navas.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Isaac Romero as he is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
75' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
73' Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Unai Lopez.
71' The ball is cleared after Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
64' Substitution. Pep Chavarria did his best and is replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Francisco has decided to substitute Sergio Camello and he is replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
58' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
58' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is caught offside!
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
54' Here is a change. Marcos Acuna is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Diego Hormigo Iturralde (Sevilla).
54' Substitution. Oliver Torres (Sevilla) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Djibril Sow walks off.
51' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
48' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
48' The attendance for today's match is 12546.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 2 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) receives a precise pass inside the box from Isaac Romero and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 1:2.

43' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Stole Dimitrievski!
40' Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
34' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.

29' 1 - 1 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the right post. Alfonso Espino assisted in the goal. 1:1.
23' A pass by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
19' 0 - 1 GOAL! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
18' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
17' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
15' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
14' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough foul. Francisco Maeso stops the game and makes a call.
13' A pass from Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland and the move breaks down.
12' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Marcao (Sevilla) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
6' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jesus Navas (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
2' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
